description: This file contains C++ source code for CUDA graph bindings in PyTorch, using pybind11 to expose CUDA graph functionalities to Python.

classes.name: _CUDAGraph
classes.description: Pybind11 wrapper class for CUDA Graph objects in PyTorch.

methods.name: capture_begin
methods.description: Starts capturing CUDA operations into a graph with specified pool and capture mode.

methods.name: capture_end
methods.description: Ends capturing CUDA operations into the graph.

methods.name: register_generator_state
methods.description: Registers a generator state with the CUDA graph.

methods.name: pool
methods.description: Returns the pool associated with the CUDA graph.

methods.name: debug_dump
methods.description: Dumps debug information of the CUDA graph.

methods.name: enable_debug_mode
methods.description: Enables debug mode for the CUDA graph.

methods.name: raw_cuda_graph
methods.description: Returns a raw pointer to the underlying CUDA graph.

methods.name: raw_cuda_graph_exec
methods.description: Returns a raw pointer to the CUDA graph execution object.
